skill.name: hubspot-company-enrich
skill.description: Finds HubSpot companies with empty industry, size or location fields, looks up each company domain with Leadsets enrich_company, and writes back only the missing values with source and checked date. Never overwrites existing data. Use when someone asks to fill blank company fields in HubSpot, backfill firmographics, fix missing industry or headcount, or clean up company records before routing or reporting.
skill.summary: Fill blank HubSpot company fields with industry, headcount bands, and location data from Leadsets.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell execution and reconnaissance matches are Markdown formatting or ordinary workflow documentation. The Leadsets endpoint supports the stated enrichment workflow, but the default preview does not gate external domain lookups or quota use. The write steps do not recheck that HubSpot fields are still empty.

remediation.issue: HubSpot domains are sent to Leadsets before the write preview.
remediation.suggestion: Show the selected scope, recipient, fields sent, and expected quota use before the first lookup. Require explicit approval or a policy that authorizes the transfer.

remediation.issue: The write plan can rely on stale HubSpot field values.
remediation.suggestion: Use conditional updates if the connector supports them. Otherwise, reread each target field immediately before writing, skip populated fields, and disclose the remaining concurrency risk.

content.value_statement: Missing company details make HubSpot routing, segmentation, and reporting less reliable. Use Leadsets to look up company domains and preview updates to blank fields.
actual_capabilities: Find HubSpot companies with blank industry, size, or location properties in a selected view, list, or filter.
Normalize and deduplicate company domains so matching HubSpot records share one Leadsets lookup.
Check Leadsets quota and test the property mapping with one company before processing the remaining domains.
Preview proposed updates to blank properties and apply them after approval in the default mode.
Report sources, check dates, conflicts, missing domains, unmatched domains, and records deferred by usage limits.
limitations: Requires a HubSpot connection and either a Leadsets MCP connection or a Leadsets REST API key.
Cannot enrich companies without a domain or fill fields when Leadsets returns no matching data.
Does not create company or contact records, enrich contact emails, or scrape company websites.
Does not convert a headcount band into an exact employee count.

use_cases.title: Prepare Accounts for Routing
use_cases.description: Fill missing industry and country values in accounts selected for a routing review.

use_cases.title: Clean Up a Recent Import
use_cases.description: Identify imported companies with missing properties and review proposed updates before writing them.

use_cases.title: Improve Segment Reporting
use_cases.description: Fill blank headcount bands in a reporting cohort and review conflicts separately.

prompt_templates.title: Preview One Company
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets to look up the company I selected. Preview a value for its blank industry field without writing to HubSpot.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Saved View
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets to look up up to 25 companies in my Recent Imports view. Preview changes to blank industry and country fields. Wait for my approval before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Map Headcount Bands
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets for up to 50 companies in the Territory Planning list. Test one domain and map headcount bands to our Employee Range dropdown. Skip unmatched options and preview the changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Check a custom property before a larger run.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quota-Aware Backfill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets for up to 200 companies created this quarter. Deduplicate domains and cap the run at the remaining allowance. Preview blank industry, city, state, and country updates. Wait for approval before writing. Report sources, check dates, conflicts, and any deferred records with the reset time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a larger backfill with usage and reporting requirements.

Two domains returned no data. One existing country value differed from Leadsets and was left unchanged.

best_practices: Confirm that your organization permits sending the selected HubSpot domains to Leadsets before starting a lookup.
Start with a small batch and review the property mapping and changes before approving writes.
Check that the target fields are still blank immediately before applying approved updates.
anti_patterns: Assuming preview mode prevents external lookups or Leadsets quota use.
Using the default scope when only a specific list is approved for enrichment.
Writing a headcount band into a property that requires an exact employee count.

faq.question: Which HubSpot properties can it fill?
faq.answer: It fills industry, headcount bands, and location fields such as city, state, and country. You can name compatible custom properties.

faq.question: What connections do I need?
faq.answer: You need a HubSpot connection and either the Leadsets MCP connection or a Leadsets REST API key. Updating records requires HubSpot write access.

faq.question: Does preview mode send data to Leadsets?
faq.answer: Yes. Preparing the preview sends company domains to Leadsets and can consume quota. The preview approval controls HubSpot writes.

faq.question: What happens to fields that already have values?
faq.answer: The skill excludes those fields when it builds the change list and reports conflicting values. Recheck fields before writing to protect concurrent edits.

faq.question: What happens when Leadsets cannot find a match?
faq.answer: The skill reports the domain as having no data and leaves the corresponding fields blank.

faq.question: How does it handle usage limits?
faq.answer: It checks available Leadsets quota before starting. If records must wait for a later window, it reports the deferred count and reset time.
